label: Austin, Texas: Tesla Gigafactory built on a gravel-pit site

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.19 relative to the control trajectory in the 12 months after 22 Jul 2020 (90% interval −0.22 to −0.11). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.19); radar has too few observations to weigh in.

notes: only 18 cells share the area's land cover (cropland); land-cover filter relaxed
kept cells within 150 m of the area's elevation (129 m)
ranked by pre-event similarity; kept the best 80
